scope: All 100 capabilities; source inventory preserved; implementation statuses are planning status, not production claims.

capabilities.title: A factory for each product
capabilities.description: Organize a product’s repositories, agents, workflows, and outcomes in one factory.
capabilities.acceptance: Switch factories and see their independent work, configuration, and results.
capabilities.implementation: Add factories beneath workspaces, default-factory migration, repository membership and a visible scope selector; preserve workspace and session identities.
capabilities.verification: Two factories show independent configuration/work/results; existing sessions retain their URLs and prior access.

capabilities.title: Cloud execution
capabilities.description: Run work continuously in shared cloud infrastructure.
capabilities.acceptance: A submitted task progresses after the initiating browser closes.
capabilities.implementation: Qualify current durable execution and expose queue/worker health in the run experience; retain Node and native Cloudflare orchestration contracts.
capabilities.verification: Work continues after the browser closes; worker restart and expired claim recover without duplicate accepted output.

capabilities.title: Human and agent collaboration
capabilities.description: Allow people and agents to contribute throughout a request’s lifecycle.
capabilities.acceptance: A person can review an artifact, request revisions, and inspect the following run.
capabilities.implementation: Unify shared discussion, clarification, steering and review around one session and exact artifact; show participants and authority.
capabilities.verification: Two people and an agent continue one session; submitted feedback survives reconnect and unauthorized/stale decisions fail.

capabilities.title: Composable infrastructure
capabilities.description: Enable individual factory capabilities to work together through clear interfaces.
capabilities.acceptance: A factory definition can independently select its runner, harness, model, integrations, and evaluation setup.
capabilities.implementation: Define typed component references and a factory compiler across workflows, agents, execution, context and evaluation; preserve existing domain ownership.
capabilities.verification: A definition resolves all references and reports missing/unsupported components before work can start.

capabilities.title: Own the factory data
capabilities.description: Let organizations control where factory inputs, traces, and outputs are retained.
capabilities.acceptance: The storage settings show the owner and location of retained data.
capabilities.implementation: Make data residency, retention, export, deletion and storage endpoints explicit; support independently owned control-plane and artifact storage.
capabilities.verification: A supported owned deployment retains data only in configured stores; deletion/export covers derived scores, memory and binary evidence.

capabilities.title: Use existing company systems
capabilities.description: Connect the factory to the team’s established tools and development process.
capabilities.acceptance: A task retains links to its source tool, repositories, and resulting changes.
capabilities.implementation: Ship the shared connector installation, source mapping, receipt and outbound delivery contract with working Slack/Linear/GitHub adapters.
capabilities.verification: Existing tools submit, follow and receive outcomes for one Wallie session with visible connection and delivery health.

capabilities.title: Declarative factory definition
capabilities.description: Describe the factory’s components and behavior in editable configuration.
capabilities.acceptance: The definition includes agents, prompts, skills, tools, repositories, runners, and triggers.
capabilities.implementation: Add versioned declarative factory files and equivalent structured editors; validate references and compile a canonical execution bundle.
capabilities.verification: UI and file edits round-trip without semantic drift; invalid definitions cannot publish.

capabilities.title: Versioned configuration
capabilities.description: Keep an identifiable history of changes to the factory.
capabilities.acceptance: Each run identifies the configuration revision used for execution.
capabilities.implementation: Store immutable complete revisions and pin a resolved execution manifest for each session/attempt, including prompt, skill, runtime and context identities.
capabilities.verification: Mid-run edits do not change the active execution or ordinary retries; new sessions use the newly published revision.

capabilities.title: Test configuration changes
capabilities.description: Try a candidate factory definition before adopting it.
capabilities.acceptance: A candidate revision can launch a comparison with the current revision.
capabilities.implementation: Add schema/reference/capability validation, semantic diffs and isolated candidate smoke runs; later attach benchmark evidence to the same draft.
capabilities.verification: An invalid or incompatible candidate is blocked; a valid candidate is tested without production publication or outbound side effects.

capabilities.title: Roll back a definition
capabilities.description: Restore a previous working factory configuration.
capabilities.acceptance: Choosing a historical revision creates a reviewable rollback with a visible diff.
capabilities.implementation: Publish/roll back by expected active revision, with an auditable activation record; restore configuration for future sessions only.
capabilities.verification: Concurrent publishers conflict visibly; rollback restores behavior for new work and leaves in-flight pins and history intact.

capabilities.title: Configure agent prompts
capabilities.description: Edit the instructions for each agent’s responsibility.
capabilities.acceptance: An agent’s Prompt tab exposes its current instructions and revision.
capabilities.implementation: Promote live stage instructions into named-agent prompt revisions while retaining generic stage templates and typed trusted/untrusted values.
capabilities.verification: A chosen agent receives its pinned prompt; changing a template cannot alter an already pinned session.

capabilities.title: Attach agent skills
capabilities.description: Choose reusable skills available to each agent.
capabilities.acceptance: The agent detail lists its skills and allows a skill to be added to its draft definition.
capabilities.implementation: Register reusable skills with immutable revision/digest, provenance and agent assignments; resolve repository skills into the execution manifest.
capabilities.verification: The run inspector shows the exact skill content/version used and a skill update affects only newly activated work.

capabilities.title: Configure agent tools
capabilities.description: Declare the MCP servers an agent can use.
capabilities.acceptance: An agent’s tools panel shows assigned MCP servers and their connection state.
capabilities.implementation: Add approved MCP/tool definitions, action scopes, credentials and capability checks; inject explicit allowed configurations into each supported harness.
capabilities.verification: An allowed tool works with scoped credentials; an unassigned server/tool cannot be invoked or inherit host configuration.

capabilities.title: Configure agent repositories
capabilities.description: Define which source repositories an agent works with.
capabilities.acceptance: An agent can select repositories belonging to the current factory.
capabilities.implementation: Assign repository sets to factories/agents and pin separately authorized read context; select one explicit writable repository per execution. Coordinated multi-repository branches/delivery are implemented under F027 in M11.
capabilities.verification: An agent can select permitted repositories and read only granted context; the trusted publisher writes only the selected execution repository, and cross-factory access is rejected.

capabilities.title: Configure agent secrets
capabilities.description: Assign the credentials required by an agent’s work.
capabilities.acceptance: An agent displays named secret references with values concealed.
capabilities.implementation: Add named secret bindings, actor/agent scopes, version/rotation metadata and least-privilege runtime grants; keep secret values outside definitions.
capabilities.verification: Runs receive only granted secrets, logs/exports redact them, and revoked or rotated bindings fail/recover according to explicit policy.

capabilities.title: Configure agent execution
capabilities.description: Choose each agent’s model, harness, and execution location.
capabilities.acceptance: Changing a model, harness, or runner produces a configuration draft.
capabilities.implementation: Separate per-agent model, harness, execution profile and budget choices; resolve them into immutable manifests instead of live workspace defaults.
capabilities.verification: Different agents use distinct approved settings; unsupported combinations are blocked and run inspection shows actual resolved choices.

capabilities.title: Foreman agent
capabilities.description: Provide a coordinating agent that accepts work and delegates it.
capabilities.acceptance: New work shows a foreman decision and the agents assigned to complete it.
capabilities.implementation: Add a coordinating foreman using typed delegation/routing commands, bounded child sessions, inherited grants and parent-owned integration.
capabilities.verification: Delegated branches run independently within root limits; their outputs cannot overwrite the parent checkpoint or publish its canonical PR.

capabilities.title: Triage incoming work
capabilities.description: Research and scope incoming requests before execution.
capabilities.acceptance: A triage step records a scope, findings, and proposed next action.
capabilities.implementation: Provide a configurable triage role that gathers evidence, asks clarifications and produces a scoped recommendation before execution.
capabilities.verification: Ambiguous input pauses for a linked clarification; actionable input advances with explicit acceptance criteria and a recorded routing decision.

capabilities.title: Collaborative specifications
capabilities.description: Let an agent and a person shape a specification together.
capabilities.acceptance: A specification can receive questions, edits, approval, and revision feedback.
capabilities.implementation: Extend existing versioned markdown/inline-review flows to collaborative specifications and clarification turns with accepted criteria.
capabilities.verification: A revised specification retains comments/history; only approval of the displayed current version enables implementation.

capabilities.title: Implementation agent
capabilities.description: Execute accepted work against the configured repositories.
capabilities.acceptance: Implementation produces a code checkpoint and reviewable output.
capabilities.implementation: Expose the existing generic implementation runner as a named configurable agent with pinned inputs, evidence and trusted publication.
capabilities.verification: A configured implementation agent completes a normal session with the same checkpoint, review and budget guarantees as today.

capabilities.title: Automated code review
capabilities.description: Use a review agent to examine the produced changes.
capabilities.acceptance: Review findings link to the change and can trigger a revision.
capabilities.implementation: Introduce configurable review-agent steps and bounded repair loops operating on exact output commits, separate from human approval.
capabilities.verification: A review finding can trigger a bounded repair; a passing agent review never substitutes for required human or delivery-policy approval.

capabilities.title: Computer-use verification
capabilities.description: Exercise the running application to verify the delivered behavior.
capabilities.acceptance: The verification step records what was exercised and links its evidence.
capabilities.implementation: Add capability-qualified computer-use verification tasks, actions/assertions and structured evidence on the exact tested app revision.
capabilities.verification: A real browser journey verifies the accepted commit; unsupported or failed verification remains explicitly incomplete.

capabilities.title: Delivery and monitoring
capabilities.description: Connect completed work to CI/CD delivery and subsequent monitoring.
capabilities.acceptance: The workflow shows delivery status and a monitoring result after review.
capabilities.implementation: Connect verified output to explicit delivery adapters and monitoring-triggered follow-up sessions; keep merge, deployment and health as distinct receipts.
capabilities.verification: An approved change is observed merged/deployed, a monitor links a new incident session, and missing delivery evidence never counts as success.

capabilities.title: Configurable human checkpoints
capabilities.description: Pause selected workflow steps for a person’s decision.
capabilities.acceptance: The workflow editor marks checkpoints, and the inbox shows pending decisions.
capabilities.implementation: Generalize checkpoint configuration and Inbox projections over existing version/artifact-bound approvals, including required approver scopes.
capabilities.verification: Simultaneous approval/rejection serializes correctly; a stale chat/API/web review token cannot advance the session.

capabilities.title: Deterministic workflow steps
capabilities.description: Use explicit rules where transitions must be predictable.
capabilities.acceptance: A transition shows its required conditions and prevents advancement until they are met.
capabilities.implementation: Add explicit deterministic step kinds and durable transition/join receipts while keeping transactional admission, validation and publication.
capabilities.verification: Restart at every transition resumes once; a policy, evidence or budget failure prevents the next step from being admitted.

capabilities.title: Intelligent task routing
capabilities.description: Let agents choose suitable paths within the configured workflow.
capabilities.acceptance: The foreman records its selected route and why it chose that route.
capabilities.implementation: Add bounded intelligent routing with allowed destinations, validated output, confidence/fallback policy and an auditable decision receipt.
capabilities.verification: Invalid routes or loops are rejected; a low-confidence decision escalates and cannot bypass gates or increase grants/budgets.

capabilities.title: Custom development lifecycles
capabilities.description: Support teams with different stages, agents, and product processes.
capabilities.acceptance: A factory can define and inspect more than one workflow.
capabilities.implementation: Evolve configurable ordered pipelines into versioned graphs with role, deterministic, gate, route, branch and join nodes plus a list editor; support coordinated multi-repository children and explicit per-repository delivery outcomes.
capabilities.verification: Existing plan/build behavior is preserved; alternative and multi-repository lifecycles execute without hardcoded stage names, remain keyboard-editable and expose partial delivery/conflicts.

capabilities.title: Direct requests
capabilities.description: Start work by describing the desired result to the factory.
capabilities.acceptance: A new request creates a visible work item and its initial run.
capabilities.implementation: Extend the current new-session flow with explicit factory/workflow/repository context and common idempotent intake semantics.
capabilities.verification: A direct request creates exactly one initial session/job/run, displays setup gaps, and survives a retried submission.

capabilities.title: Slack conversations
capabilities.description: Submit and follow factory work from Slack.
capabilities.acceptance: The connector preview shows a request, status replies, and a review handoff in its source thread.
capabilities.implementation: Implement Slack installation, channel/thread intake, mapped actors, follow-ups, review links/actions and durable outcome replies.
capabilities.verification: A real Slack thread completes intake through outcome; duplicates, edits, revocation and reply failures preserve one linked session.

capabilities.title: Microsoft Teams conversations
capabilities.description: Submit and follow factory work from Teams.
capabilities.acceptance: A Teams connector maps a conversation to a factory work item.
capabilities.implementation: Implement Teams tenant/application setup and conversation/card actions over shared intake/review/outbound contracts.
capabilities.verification: A real Teams conversation can initiate, clarify, review and follow a task; stale cards and revoked users cannot authorize work.

capabilities.title: Linear work intake
capabilities.description: Use Linear issues as work inputs and link resulting activity back.
capabilities.acceptance: A work item shows its Linear issue and synchronized progress.
capabilities.implementation: Extend existing linked-issue polling to discover eligible work and map issue/project/state rules without duplicating source-span handling.
capabilities.verification: A qualifying Linear issue is admitted once, state leave/return is handled correctly, and linked session/results remain navigable.

capabilities.title: Jira work intake
capabilities.description: Use Jira tasks as factory work inputs.
capabilities.acceptance: A Jira connector routes a matching task into a selected workflow.
capabilities.implementation: Implement Jira project scopes, issue intake/transitions, webhook/poll recovery, comments and outcome links using common receipts.
capabilities.verification: A real Jira issue completes the configured workflow; duplicate/out-of-order events and disconnected projects cannot create duplicate work.

capabilities.title: GitHub work intake
capabilities.description: Start and follow work through GitHub issues and pull requests.
capabilities.acceptance: A GitHub event creates or updates a work item with source links.
capabilities.implementation: Extend GitHub installations and verified webhooks to issue/PR work intake and follow-up comments while retaining current PR reconciliation.
capabilities.verification: A real issue or PR trigger creates one session, follows its conversation and returns the result without weakening GitHub delivery verification.

capabilities.title: GitLab access
capabilities.description: Support GitLab as a source-code and work access point.
capabilities.acceptance: A GitLab connector shows repository access and an event-to-workflow mapping.
capabilities.implementation: Add GitLab repository access, protected refs, checkpoint publication, MR/check/review verification, intake and outcome adapters.
capabilities.verification: A task runs from a GitLab repo through exact retained refs to a verified MR; cancellation and permission changes preserve lineage.

capabilities.title: Factory MCP
capabilities.description: Let external coding agents submit work and inspect the factory through MCP.
capabilities.acceptance: The developer panel shows tools for creating work, reading runs, and retrieving results.
capabilities.implementation: Expose scoped factory/session/run/configuration commands through MCP and document local coding-agent setup; reuse the versioned API domain commands.
capabilities.verification: A local coding agent submits and follows work through MCP without browser cookies or service-role keys; revoked scopes stop access.

capabilities.title: API and custom interfaces
capabilities.description: Expose the factory’s capabilities to APIs and independently built user interfaces.
capabilities.acceptance: An API example creates a work item and returns an identifier usable for status queries.
capabilities.implementation: Provide versioned external APIs, scoped machine credentials, idempotency, cursor pagination, subscriptions/webhooks and CLI/SDK examples for custom UIs.
capabilities.verification: A custom client creates, follows and reviews permitted work with stable errors, global rate limits and audit; another tenant cannot enumerate data.

capabilities.title: Automated work triggers
capabilities.description: Send scheduled or event-driven work through the same configurable workflows.
capabilities.acceptance: An automation has a trigger, selected workflow, prompt, enabled state, and execution history.
capabilities.implementation: Add one durable automation engine with revisions, filters, target workflow/agent, dry run, pause, occurrence receipts and controlled retry.
capabilities.verification: Dry runs have no external effects; redelivery/restart creates one logical occurrence and pausing prevents new admissions.

capabilities.title: Agent automation assignments
capabilities.description: See which automations can invoke each agent.
capabilities.acceptance: An agent’s Automations tab links to every configured trigger for it.
capabilities.implementation: Bind automations to approved named agents/workflows, service identity, root budget and configuration revision.
capabilities.verification: An unattended trigger resolves the assigned agent and credentials explicitly; changing ownership or revoking grants blocks future work.

capabilities.title: Shared activity across factories
capabilities.description: See the work agents are doing across the organization in real time.
capabilities.acceptance: The activity view updates and can be filtered by factory and status.
capabilities.implementation: Add factory-scoped and authorized all-factory activity views with stable session/run links and clear scope labels.
capabilities.verification: Activity from two factories aggregates only when authorized; switching factory never changes an open session or draft's ownership.

capabilities.title: Shared run inspection
capabilities.description: Open another team member’s agent run to understand its progress.
capabilities.acceptance: A run displays its initiator, active agent, progress, and output.
capabilities.implementation: Extract shared Runs list/detail from existing session activity with bounded pagination, normalized state and inspection links.
capabilities.verification: Any authorized teammate can inspect a run, follow live updates and reopen historical data without loading every transcript initially.

capabilities.title: Source conversation links
capabilities.description: Return directly from a run to the conversation that started it.
capabilities.acceptance: The run header links to the original issue or chat thread.
capabilities.implementation: Store normalized origin/thread/message/actor references and render source deep links beside sessions, runs and decisions.
capabilities.verification: Run-to-source and source-to-session links survive retries; unavailable/deleted/private origins are represented without leaking content.

capabilities.title: Automatic run history
capabilities.description: Retain the organization’s coding-agent activity centrally.
capabilities.acceptance: Completed and failed runs remain searchable with their metadata.
capabilities.implementation: Make retained run history a durable indexed catalog with attempt identities, pagination, lifecycle and retention metadata.
capabilities.verification: Successful, failed, canceled and interrupted attempts remain distinguishable and inspectable after reconnect/restart.

capabilities.title: Work across access points
capabilities.description: Continue work with the same cloud context when moving between connected tools.
capabilities.acceptance: A work item displays activity from multiple source surfaces under one identity.
capabilities.implementation: Create a shared conversation/command identity so UI, API and later connector follow-ups operate on the same context and decision state.
capabilities.verification: A request begun in one access point continues in another with no duplicated session, missing feedback or broadened authority.

capabilities.title: Complete agent transcripts
capabilities.description: Retain conversations and tool activity as inputs for inspection and improvement.
capabilities.acceptance: The run detail shows the ordered transcript with tool calls and results.
capabilities.implementation: Version the sanitized transcript schema with ordered tool/text/result events, causation IDs, adapter completeness markers and paginated retention.
capabilities.verification: Supported adapters retain complete observable events; omitted provider data is labeled, secrets are absent, and replays preserve ordering.

capabilities.title: External context sources
capabilities.description: Pull relevant context through MCP servers and APIs.
capabilities.acceptance: A context source has a connection, assigned agents, and a test action.
capabilities.implementation: Add external-context connectors, ACL-aware sync/retrieval, freshness, immutable snapshots and bounded context packing.
capabilities.verification: The run shows exactly which source revisions were read; removed source access prevents retrieval and cross-factory leakage.

capabilities.title: Durable run artifacts
capabilities.description: Keep outputs produced by agents after execution finishes.
capabilities.acceptance: Artifacts can be opened from their producing run and work item.
capabilities.implementation: Catalog immutable markdown, reports, logs and checkpoint artifacts with type, digest, run/commit provenance and retention state.
capabilities.verification: An artifact can be retrieved by authorized users with its producing run/commit; expired, missing or mismatched objects remain explicit.

capabilities.title: Screenshot evidence
capabilities.description: Attach visual proof to delivered changes and verification steps.
capabilities.acceptance: A reviewer can open the screenshot evidence for the exact run.
capabilities.implementation: Add trusted screenshot capture/upload, sanitation metadata, immutable object digests and private exact-run viewers.
capabilities.verification: Screenshots from the wrong commit cannot satisfy review; private assets enforce access and show redaction/unavailability states.

capabilities.title: Video evidence
capabilities.description: Retain video demonstrations produced during agent verification.
capabilities.acceptance: The evidence panel can play a linked demonstration with its run identity.
capabilities.implementation: Add video capture, duration/codec limits, transcript/caption references, private streaming and timestamp-linked verification steps.
capabilities.verification: A reviewer plays a retained walkthrough tied to the tested commit; corruption, blocked access and retention expiry fail clearly.

capabilities.title: Factory memory
capabilities.description: Make useful retained knowledge available to later agent work.
capabilities.acceptance: A memory entry shows its content, source, scope, and revision.
capabilities.implementation: Add factory memory with source/run provenance, review/correction, scope, expiry and forgetting; snapshot the memory actually used.
capabilities.verification: An approved memory helps a later task, correction creates a version, forgetting removes retrieval eligibility, and old replay remains honestly classified.

capabilities.title: Central context continuity
capabilities.description: Keep the context needed by successive agents in one shared system.
capabilities.acceptance: The work item exposes the context and outputs passed between its agents.
capabilities.implementation: Resolve one context manifest from conversation, code, prior accepted artifacts, external snapshots and memory for each continuation.
capabilities.verification: Continuation uses accepted context consistently across access points; replay never substitutes current memory for a historical snapshot.

capabilities.title: Isolated sandboxes
capabilities.description: Run agents in constrained environments appropriate to their work.
capabilities.acceptance: Every run identifies its sandbox, runner, and lifecycle state.
capabilities.implementation: Preserve existing sandbox isolation and extend qualification/visibility to owned execution profiles, egress and lifecycle controls.
capabilities.verification: Concurrent untrusted tasks cannot share undeclared files/secrets; cancellation/reaping records confirmed versus attempted cleanup.

capabilities.title: Multiple sandbox providers
capabilities.description: Choose the execution platform suited to the factory.
capabilities.acceptance: The runner selector offers multiple connected providers.
capabilities.implementation: Consolidate driver capability metadata and qualify Vercel/E2B/Daytona plus owned-runner profiles through one provider contract.
capabilities.verification: Every advertised provider passes creation, execution, artifact transfer, cancellation and recovery checks; incompatible choices cannot schedule.

capabilities.title: Own compute
capabilities.description: Run factory agents on infrastructure controlled by the organization.
capabilities.acceptance: A self-hosted runner displays its connection, availability, and assigned factory.
capabilities.implementation: Add owned runner enrollment, outbound leases, ephemeral task isolation, capacity, drain/revocation and Docker/Kubernetes/direct backends.
capabilities.verification: Work runs on registered owned compute; lost/revoked runners cannot accept new work or publish late results, and cleanup is auditable.

capabilities.title: Multiple operating platforms
capabilities.description: Support execution requirements beyond a single operating platform.
capabilities.acceptance: Runner profiles identify their operating platform and capabilities.
capabilities.implementation: Implement explicit Linux/macOS/Windows platform bootstraps and shell/path/process capability profiles; qualify declared architectures and tools.
capabilities.verification: Each advertised native OS executes a real task with file/Git/browser/process/cancel proof; unsupported model/harness/OS combinations are shown.

capabilities.title: Pluggable agent harnesses
capabilities.description: Select different coding-agent runtimes for factory work.
capabilities.acceptance: A run can choose a supported harness and records the chosen runtime.
capabilities.implementation: Publish a harness extension contract and qualify Codex/Claude Code/Cursor/OpenCode against supported profiles, events and authoritative output.
capabilities.verification: A declared harness produces normalized transcript, final output and usage or explicit unavailable values; the extension conformance suite passes.

capabilities.title: Pluggable models
capabilities.description: Use models from multiple providers with supported agent harnesses.
capabilities.acceptance: A configuration names its provider and model independently of its workflow.
capabilities.implementation: Separate model catalog/identity/capabilities from harness and provider authentication; expose compatible model selection and resolved provenance.
capabilities.verification: A model can change without changing the workflow; compatibility and alias/version uncertainty are recorded rather than assumed.

capabilities.title: Organization inference gateway
capabilities.description: Send inference through the organization’s chosen gateway.
capabilities.acceptance: The inference configuration includes a named gateway connection and health state.
capabilities.implementation: Add organization inference gateway profiles, endpoint/protocol validation, egress rules, credential binding, catalog and usage adapters.
capabilities.verification: Approved requests route through the configured gateway; connection/usage failures are explicit and no unconfigured fallback leaks requests elsewhere.

capabilities.title: Self-hosted models
capabilities.description: Use model deployments controlled by the organization.
capabilities.acceptance: A model connection can reference a self-hosted inference endpoint.
capabilities.implementation: Support self-hosted inference endpoints with readiness/capacity and model/harness capability checks over the gateway contract.
capabilities.verification: An owned model completes a supported task with no mandatory external inference path; unavailable accounting remains visible and budgets enforce policy.

capabilities.title: Workflow flow metrics
capabilities.description: Understand how work moves through the factory and where it waits.
capabilities.acceptance: The dashboard shows time spent in execution, waiting, review, and delivery.
capabilities.implementation: Add transactional lifecycle events and tenant-scoped projections for queue, active, blocked, review and delivery flow; backfill only provable history.
capabilities.verification: Known fixtures reconcile each time interval and count to source runs/events; missing historical intervals are reported as unknown.

capabilities.title: Cost per pull request
capabilities.description: Relate total work cost to the changes produced.
capabilities.acceptance: A PR cost detail links to its contributing runs and shows missing cost coverage.
capabilities.implementation: Compute cost per merged PR using attributable attempts including failures/retries, with cohort, numerator, denominator and coverage shown.
capabilities.verification: A merged-PR cohort reconciles to exact run charges without double counting; zero merges yields unavailable and partial spend never appears complete.

capabilities.title: Time to delivery
capabilities.description: Measure how long work takes to reach delivery.
capabilities.acceptance: Cycle-time charts include definitions and let the user inspect contributing work items.
capabilities.implementation: Ingest authenticated read-only deployment observations before active delivery adapters arrive; measure request-to-merge and separately request-to-observed-deploy time, with active, queue and human wait durations.
capabilities.verification: Drilldown explains the median/distribution from timestamps; stage approval or session archival is not silently treated as delivery.

capabilities.title: Metrics by source and person
capabilities.description: Compare work outcomes across intake sources and team members.
capabilities.acceptance: Source and initiator filters update the dashboard cohort.
capabilities.implementation: Add source and actor dimensions with distinct initiating human, service principal, approver and assignee identities.
capabilities.verification: Filters reconcile with total cohorts, unattributed historical work stays unknown, and permission boundaries apply to drilldowns/exports.

capabilities.title: Metrics by agent and model
capabilities.description: Inspect cost and performance for individual agent and model choices.
capabilities.acceptance: The dashboard can group runs and costs by agent and model.
capabilities.implementation: Group usage, outcomes and duration by pinned agent, model, harness and configuration, retaining provenance and estimate revision.
capabilities.verification: Changing a live agent name/model does not rewrite historical attribution; group totals reconcile to underlying run accounting.

capabilities.title: Pull-request throughput
capabilities.description: Track how much change the factory produces over time.
capabilities.acceptance: The throughput chart counts unique PRs in a displayed time window.
capabilities.implementation: Retain authoritative merge timestamps/identities and build unique merged-PR throughput cohorts with late/out-of-order event reconciliation.
capabilities.verification: Duplicate events and multiple runs for one PR count one merge; closed-unmerged PRs do not contribute.

capabilities.title: Revert rate
capabilities.description: Track reversals as a quality signal alongside throughput.
capabilities.acceptance: The dashboard links each counted revert to its original delivered change.
capabilities.implementation: Track explicit/verified revert relations with a defined observation window, maturity and unknown cases; support reviewed correction of ambiguous links.
capabilities.verification: Revert rate is computed on eligible merged changes, displays its window/coverage, and never treats uncertain or unobserved reversions as zero.

capabilities.title: Online run evaluation
capabilities.description: Evaluate production agent runs after they finish.
capabilities.acceptance: A completed run can show attached evaluation results with scorer identity.
capabilities.implementation: Add independent durable evaluation jobs for completed attempts and versioned score receipts; isolate evaluator capacity and spend.
capabilities.verification: Duplicate completion events produce one result per scorer revision; judge failure stays unavailable and never blocks source publication by accident.

capabilities.title: LLM judges
capabilities.description: Use a configured model to assess a run against a rubric.
capabilities.acceptance: A scorer specifies a judge model, rubric, and result format.
capabilities.implementation: Implement model-based judges over bounded untrusted run evidence with structured output validation and evaluator provenance.
capabilities.verification: Malformed outputs, evidence injection and unavailable judges fail safely; judge identity, rubric revision, evidence digest and cost are retained.

capabilities.title: Custom quality dimensions
capabilities.description: Define evaluation criteria that reflect the team’s own failures and goals.
capabilities.acceptance: Users can create a scorer for a named criterion and inspect example outcomes.
capabilities.implementation: Add configurable quality dimensions/rubrics with human-readable criteria, calibration examples and deterministic checks where appropriate.
capabilities.verification: A team creates a new dimension and obtains traceable results on known passing/failing/unscorable examples.

capabilities.title: Redundant-test detection
capabilities.description: Identify runs that spend effort creating unnecessary tests.
capabilities.acceptance: A redundant-tests scorer links its finding to evidence from the run.
capabilities.implementation: Ship the redundant-test/scaffolding rubric as a reusable scorer template with code-diff evidence and explanatory findings.
capabilities.verification: The scorer distinguishes useful regression coverage from unrelated scaffolding against reviewed fixtures and exposes disputed results for correction.

capabilities.title: Sampling strategy
capabilities.description: Control the proportion of runs evaluated to manage evaluation expense.
capabilities.acceptance: A scorer shows its sampling percentage and eligible population.
capabilities.implementation: Add deterministic sampling policies by rate/cohort, seed, exclusions and budget, with inclusion receipts and backfill controls.
capabilities.verification: The same policy/seed selects the same eligible runs; dashboard shows eligible/sample counts and retries do not resample or double charge.

capabilities.title: Pass and fail criteria
capabilities.description: Make the threshold for a scorer result explicit.
capabilities.acceptance: Scorer configuration displays the criteria that determine a passing result.
capabilities.implementation: Version score thresholds, pass/fail/unknown semantics and evidence eligibility independently of numeric values.
capabilities.verification: Boundary values and missing evidence produce the documented result; threshold edits do not rewrite previous judgments.

capabilities.title: Scorers in factory configuration
capabilities.description: Version evaluation definitions with the rest of the factory.
capabilities.acceptance: A scorer edit appears in the factory definition diff.
capabilities.implementation: Extend the factory definition schema/compiler with scorer bindings, judge/sampling policies and revision references.
capabilities.verification: Exported and activated configuration selects exact scorers and thresholds; historical evaluations retain their pinned definitions.

capabilities.title: Score trends
capabilities.description: Track whether evaluation results improve over time.
capabilities.acceptance: A scorer detail shows historical results with sample counts and links to runs.
capabilities.implementation: Add trends, score coverage, version/cohort comparisons and run-evidence drilldowns in Scorers and Analytics.
capabilities.verification: Trend totals reconcile to sampled results; rubric changes are labeled and unlike versions are not silently combined into one improvement claim.

capabilities.title: Recurring failure analysis
capabilities.description: Find patterns across runs that receive failing scores.
capabilities.acceptance: An improvement candidate groups related failures with a count and evidence links.
capabilities.implementation: Cluster recurring failures by version/cohort and evidence, with minimum sample support, duplicates and reviewed labels.
capabilities.verification: A failure group links all contributing evaluations; low-support or mixed-version patterns are marked inconclusive.

capabilities.title: Identify the responsible agent
capabilities.description: Trace recurring problems to the agent or factory configuration that caused them.
capabilities.acceptance: The candidate identifies affected agents and explains its proposed cause.
capabilities.implementation: Attribute failures to pinned agent/workflow steps using traces and lineage, preserving uncertain and multi-agent responsibility.
capabilities.verification: A proposal identifies supporting steps/runs and distinguishes observed ownership from inferred root cause.

capabilities.title: Propose factory changes
capabilities.description: Have agents suggest edits to the factory’s definition.
capabilities.acceptance: An improvement detail shows the proposed configuration diff.
capabilities.implementation: Generate bounded candidate prompt/skill/workflow/scorer/routing patches as draft factory revisions with rationale and evidence.
capabilities.verification: The proposed diff is scoped and reviewable, validates against the schema, and cannot alter active production configuration automatically.

capabilities.title: Reviewable improvement PRs
capabilities.description: Submit changes to factory behavior through pull requests.
capabilities.acceptance: A proposal links to a PR and has visible review and adoption states.
capabilities.implementation: Open reviewable improvement PRs against the configured definition repository with provenance, diff, evidence and required human review.
capabilities.verification: A PR reproduces the exact candidate revision and tests; merge alone cannot silently bypass activation controls or stale-base checks.

capabilities.title: Validate proposed improvements
capabilities.description: Use observed results to judge whether a factory change helps.
capabilities.acceptance: The proposal links to comparison runs and records the adoption decision.
capabilities.implementation: Compare baseline and candidate on matched held-out tasks, review results, then activate/canary/roll back through the definition lifecycle.
capabilities.verification: A purported improvement is blocked on regression or insufficient evidence; adoption records comparison IDs and subsequent outcome monitoring.

capabilities.title: Curated benchmark suites
capabilities.description: Collect representative real tasks into reusable evaluation sets.
capabilities.acceptance: A suite displays its task set and supports adding or removing tasks.
capabilities.implementation: Add versioned curated suites with task membership, acceptance criteria, provenance and eligibility state.
capabilities.verification: Editing a suite creates a revision; completed comparisons retain their original task set and no historical result changes retrospectively.

capabilities.title: Add a past run to a benchmark
capabilities.description: Promote an interesting completed task into a reusable benchmark case.
capabilities.acceptance: The run menu can add the run to a named benchmark suite.
capabilities.implementation: Capture a past run as a benchmark task with original prompt, starting refs, context, config and task-specific acceptance criteria.
capabilities.verification: The task appears once in its suite with a snapshot preview; missing required inputs mark it non-replayable instead of silently substituting data.

capabilities.title: Task-specific suites
capabilities.description: Create focused groups such as difficult tasks or frontend changes.
capabilities.acceptance: Suites can be labeled by task type and inspected independently.
capabilities.implementation: Support specialized suites by work type with tags, selection rules, reviewed acceptance and frozen explicit membership.
capabilities.verification: UI, data and triage suites can be curated independently and comparisons disclose the exact selected membership.

capabilities.title: Replay from the starting state
capabilities.description: Repeat historical work using the state available when it began.
capabilities.acceptance: A benchmark task shows its fixed starting commit, task inputs, and factory revision.
capabilities.implementation: Restore historical repositories, prompt/context/skill state and execution profile in isolated trial sessions; record limits to reproducibility.
capabilities.verification: A replay verifies input digests and retained refs; deleted context or unavailable model versions block exact-replay claims or require an explicitly labeled variant.

capabilities.title: Control replay side effects
capabilities.description: Make historical task replay safe for the external systems it touches.
capabilities.acceptance: Replay settings display how repository publication and external writes are isolated.
capabilities.implementation: Enforce replay tool/network/credential policy with recorded read fixtures and blocked or test-scoped writes; prevent production PR/chat/deploy effects.
capabilities.verification: A side-effecting replay cannot modify production repositories, tools or messages; denied operations remain part of task evidence.

capabilities.title: Model comparison matrix
capabilities.description: Run the same tasks against different model configurations.
capabilities.acceptance: A comparison includes at least two model candidates and per-task results.
capabilities.implementation: Create budgeted model matrices with repetitions, randomized scheduling/seeds and durable trial state over frozen task/configuration snapshots.
capabilities.verification: Requested tasks × candidates × repetitions reconcile to trial receipts including failures/cancellations and reserved/actual spend.

capabilities.title: Harness comparison matrix
capabilities.description: Compare coding-agent harnesses against the same tasks.
capabilities.acceptance: A comparison can vary the harness while preserving task inputs.
capabilities.implementation: Vary harness independently from model and runtime; select only qualified pairs and record harness/toolchain versions.
capabilities.verification: A same-model harness comparison reports differing tool capabilities and accounts for every trial without pretending pairs are equivalent.

capabilities.title: Factory configuration comparison
capabilities.description: Compare changes to the overall factory setup on representative work.
capabilities.acceptance: The benchmark records the factory revision associated with each candidate.
capabilities.implementation: Run baseline/candidate factory definitions against identical eligible task/context snapshots and compute per-task deltas.
capabilities.verification: Candidate configuration changes are isolated; differences and incompatibilities are visible and no trial mutates active definitions.

capabilities.title: Selectable scoring dimensions
capabilities.description: Choose which evaluation criteria determine benchmark performance.
capabilities.acceptance: The benchmark exposes the selected scorers and each dimension’s result.
capabilities.implementation: Select versioned correctness, scope, verification and other scorers per experiment, with independent evaluation budgets.
capabilities.verification: Results identify every selected dimension/version and include missing or disputed scores rather than dropping inconvenient trials.

capabilities.title: Cost and quality frontier
capabilities.description: Display the tradeoff between a configuration’s cost and its measured quality.
capabilities.acceptance: A chart places candidates by cost and score, with selectable points and underlying results.
capabilities.implementation: Render cost-quality frontier, uncertainty/sample support, repetitions and transparent recommendation thresholds with accessible tables.
capabilities.verification: Frontier/recommendation agrees with trial totals; unknown cost and insufficient evidence cannot win by being represented as zero.

capabilities.title: Task-level benchmark evidence
capabilities.description: Inspect the trials behind an aggregate benchmark result.
capabilities.acceptance: Selecting a result opens its run, output, usage, and evaluation evidence.
capabilities.implementation: Provide task/trial drilldowns into frozen inputs, output diff, transcript, score explanations, screenshots/video when required and failure details.
capabilities.verification: Each comparison cell opens its exact trial evidence; missing/retained/redacted evidence states stay distinct.

capabilities.title: Apply benchmark findings
capabilities.description: Convert evidence from a task suite into a model-selection decision.
capabilities.acceptance: A selected benchmark candidate can create a proposed routing rule.
capabilities.implementation: Turn a benchmark finding into a reviewed routing candidate with supporting suite/run IDs and controlled activation.
capabilities.verification: Applying a result creates a revision, never silently changes current work, and is blocked if evidence/configuration is stale.

capabilities.title: Route by task class
capabilities.description: Choose a suitable model and harness for similar future requests.
capabilities.acceptance: Routing rules match a task category and identify the configuration selected.
capabilities.implementation: Add ordered task-class rules, explicit fallback/escalation and recorded rule/model/harness resolution before execution.
capabilities.verification: Tasks in different classes use the intended qualified configuration; unmatched or unavailable choices take only the configured fallback.

capabilities.title: Explicit cost-quality preference
capabilities.description: Let teams choose the quality and cost tradeoff appropriate to their work.
capabilities.acceptance: A routing decision shows the benchmark evidence and the selected tradeoff.
capabilities.implementation: Expose quality floors, cost/latency ceilings and confidence/sample requirements as explicit routing preferences.
capabilities.verification: Changing the preference yields a traceable candidate; a cheap low-quality or unmeasured option cannot satisfy the stated quality/cost policy.

capabilities.title: Central agent governance
capabilities.description: Give the organization a central place to control agent access and execution.
capabilities.acceptance: The settings view identifies who can configure the factory, run agents, and review work.
capabilities.implementation: Add factory-scoped grants, audit and named service-principal authority records with credential owner and budget payer, plus repository/tool/data scopes. M04 adds external authentication to these principals; current authorization surfaces enforce the grants immediately.
capabilities.verification: Cross-factory/tenant access is denied, revocation affects future claims, current human access is preserved through migration and every privileged change is attributable.

capabilities.title: Scheduled factory work
capabilities.description: Launch recurring reports, maintenance, or analysis on a schedule.
capabilities.acceptance: A scheduled automation shows its timing, target agent, prompt, and recent runs.
capabilities.implementation: Add schedules with timezone/DST/missed-run semantics, stable occurrence IDs, preview/test, pause and scheduling ownership.
capabilities.verification: Restart, overlap and DST fixtures execute each intended occurrence once; missed-run behavior is explicit and inspectable.

capabilities.title: Pull-request event triggers
capabilities.description: React to pull-request reviews, closures, and merges.
capabilities.acceptance: A trigger maps selected pull-request events to an agent and workflow.
capabilities.implementation: Normalize verified PR/MR events into automation filters and durable occurrences without weakening existing verification refresh receipts.
capabilities.verification: Duplicate/out-of-order events are idempotent; factory-created PR events cannot recursively trigger unbounded work.

capabilities.title: Issue event triggers
capabilities.description: Launch work from issue mentions, labels, assignments, or task changes.
capabilities.acceptance: A trigger preview shows the matching issue event and the work that would start.
capabilities.implementation: Normalize issue events and polling state spans into common trigger evaluation with source cursors and deduplication.
capabilities.verification: Repeated polls/webhooks cause one logical admission; actual leave-and-return follows configured semantics with an auditable receipt.

capabilities.title: Chat event triggers
capabilities.description: Start work from directed messages and mentions in team chat.
capabilities.acceptance: A chat trigger identifies its channel or direct-message source and target agent.
capabilities.implementation: Add chat mention/message filters and follow-up routing with bot-loop protection, actor grants and thread continuity.
capabilities.verification: Messages create or continue the intended session once; bot replies, edits and unauthorized mentions cannot create recursive work.

capabilities.title: Self-hostable release
capabilities.description: Package the complete Wallie factory for deployment in the operator’s own environment.
capabilities.acceptance: The deployment screen describes required services, setup steps, and a versioned release.
capabilities.implementation: Release the complete supported self-hosted stack with install/upgrade/backup/restore/drain procedures and operating health for all100 capabilities.
capabilities.verification: A clean owned install and an upgrade from today's schema complete the full factory loop, restore metadata/assets/keys and recover active work.

capabilities.title: Portable factory export
capabilities.description: Export a factory definition for review, migration, and reuse.
capabilities.acceptance: Export produces a readable configuration with secret references and a declared schema version.
capabilities.implementation: Export/import portable versioned factory bundles with pinned prompts/skills/workflows/scorers/routing and remapped connector/secret references.
capabilities.verification: Round-trip into another instance preserves semantics, omits secret values and requires missing bindings/capabilities to validate before activation.

capabilities.title: Contribution and licensing surface
capabilities.description: Make the project’s license, source, contribution process, and roadmap easy to find.
capabilities.acceptance: The product links to the repository and clearly identifies its release and license.
capabilities.implementation: Extend existing MIT contribution/security docs with extension contracts, sample factories, reproducible releases, SBOM/provenance and visible source/license links.
capabilities.verification: An external contributor installs, runs conformance checks, adds a documented adapter and reproduces a tagged release without private services.

milestones.title: Shared work, Inbox and programmable access
